Install a list of selected packages by theme

install_selected.Rd

Install a list of selected packages (from CRAN and GitHub) by theme (spatial, moveco, tidyverse, tidymodels, plotting, data, stats, utils).

Usage

install_selected(
  spatial,
  moveco,
  tidyverse,
  tidymodels,
  plotting,
  data,
  stats,
  utils
)

Arguments

spatial

Logical, whether to install spatial packages (defaults to TRUE).

moveco

Logical, whether to install moveco packages (defaults to TRUE).

tidyverse

Logical, whether to install tidyverse packages (defaults to TRUE).

tidymodels

Logical, whether to install tidymodels packages (defaults to FALSE).

plotting

Logical, whether to install plotting packages (defaults to TRUE).

data

Logical, whether to install data packages (defaults to TRUE).

stats

Logical, whether to install stats packages (defaults to TRUE).

utils

Logical, whether to install utils packages (defaults to TRUE).

Value

(Invisibly) A data frame with information about the installed package(s).

Here is the full list of packages:

Requires package pak.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Install all packages (except 'tidymodels'):
install_selected()

## Only install spatial packages:
install_selected(spatial = TRUE, moveco = FALSE, tidyverse = FALSE, tidymodels = FALSE,
    plotting = FALSE, data = FALSE, stats = FALSE, utils = FALSE)} # }
